raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 was delivered twice (02:00 and 05:00 ingest_ts), so raw_transactions has 349 txn_ids that are identical except for ingest_ts. silver_transactions has no dedup step, so the duplicates inflate silver and all the gold tables. Deduplicating by txn_id in silver fixes this, because the copies carry the same data.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.95,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1;"}}
